resources.string: Changes flow in both directions. Simultaneous edits keep both versions. A saved baseline and valid checksums are required before scheduled runs can start.

Initialisation combines both folders. Files present on only one side are copied. When both sides contain different versions, the selected side overwrites the other. This is separate from normal conflict handling.
A normal run stops if a side exceeds this percentage of deletions. This does not limit overwrites during initialisation. Set up backups for important data.
Require access markers in both folders
Create a file named RCLONE_TEST in each folder before enabling this. A missing marker stops the run. Markers are never created or bypassed automatically.
Backup folders must be outside the synchronised folders. The remote backup must use the same remote, for example proton:Backups. Local backups contain readable file contents.

Optional: type one flag per line: --flag, --flag value or --flag=value. Leave blank to use the defaults. Spaces in values do not need quotes. Credentials belong in the remote editor. The bundled engine checks option names and values before running.

For a Proton Drive remote, edit login details or explicitly reset and verify its cached session. Other tasks for the same declared account remain paused until verification succeeds. This does not initialise or repair a bisync baseline. Resolve human-verification challenges in an official Proton client.
Verifying Proton connection. Cancellation leaves account jobs paused.
Proton connection verified. Review any interrupted bisync baseline separately.
Password is protected by Android Keystore. Enter a replacement, or leave blank to remove it.
Could not protect or unlock the proxy password. Re-enter it before using the proxy.

Start with Resync to save the task, confirm its settings and create a baseline. Resync transfers files and may overwrite different versions according to the selected preference. Once ready, use Run for normal two-way synchronisation.
Defaults are enough to start. Type custom flags below if needed. The reference lists the bundled engine flags and explains them.
Use only if Proton needs you to sign in again. This does not initialise your sync.

Check these settings and your backups. Resync combines both folders and creates a new baseline. It can overwrite differing files according to the selected preference. The normal deletion limit does not limit these overwrites.\n\n%1$s
No completed runs have been recorded.
Leave both blank to disable. Times use the device timezone. Manual runs still respect network and battery conditions.
Unsupported task mode. Choose a supported mode explicitly to migrate this task.
Android may defer execution for network, battery or system limits. Missed runs are combined into one pending task.
No schedules are saved for this task.
Select a configured remote before saving this task.
Remote %1$s is unavailable. Reconnect it or explicitly select another remote.
Select a valid folder from this ProtonBridge installation.
Wait for a network Android marks as unmetered, usually Wi-Fi or Ethernet. Metered Wi-Fi is excluded.
Compares file size and a common checksum. Missing checksums stop the run rather than silently reducing protection.

Local reference from the bundled rclone engine, with flag descriptions and defaults. It does not run a sync or connect to your account. Search by name or explanation. Some flags are managed by the task controls or belong in the remote editor and cannot be overridden here. For example, --conflict-resolve newer prefers the newer file while preserving the losing version as a numbered conflict copy. Changing listing policy requires confirming Resync; recover and resilient can be enabled for an existing matching baseline.
